title: SiriusXM’s Holiday Music Channels Are Back for 2026
summary: Find your favorite holiday channels, including Jimmy Fallon’s Holiday Seasoning Radio, Hallmark Radio, Holly, and more.
body_markdown:
’Tis the season for holiday music! SiriusXM’s 2026 holiday lineup features 25 festive channels, including favorites from[Jimmy Fallon](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/jimmy-fallon) ,[Hallmark](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/hallmark-radio) ,[Trans-Siberian Orchestra](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/trans-siberian-orchestra-radio) , and more.


From traditional Christmas classics and country favorites to holiday rock, jazz, Hanukkah music, and beyond, there’s something for everyone. Holiday programming begins Monday, November 2, with channels available on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogHolidayChannels2026) and select channels in cars.


## SiriusXM Holiday Music Channels for 2026


### Share Your Holiday Greetings on SiriusXM


Listeners can send personalized voice or video messages, request favorite songs, share holiday memories or offer a seasonal shout-out for a chance to be featured on a holiday channel. Visit[SiriusXM Season’s Greetings](https://www.siriusxm.com/seasonsgreetings) to participate.


### Full Lineup, Channel Numbers, and Dates


Find your favorites below, including where to listen and when each channel is available.


**70s/80s Holidays** features holiday hits from the Carpenters and the Jackson 5 to Wham! and Bruce Springsteen. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Acoustic Christmas** features laid-back holiday songs from Taylor Swift, Phoebe Bridgers, Kacey Musgraves, the Lumineers, and more. **Car:** Ch. 17: Dec. 24–25
**App:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Christmas Spirit** celebrates the season with contemporary Christian Christmas favorites from artists heard on SiriusXM’s The Message. **Car:** Ch. 79: Dec. 2–27
**App:** Nov. 2–Jan. 6


**Cool Jazz Christmas** brings smooth jazz holiday favorites from Dave Koz, Kenny G, Diana Krall, Laufey, and more. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Country Christmas** features classic and contemporary holiday songs from George Strait, Carrie Underwood, Willie Nelson, Lainey Wilson, and more. **Car:** Ch. 58: Dec. 2–27
**App:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Hallmark Radio** plays timeless Christmas carols and new songs from Hallmark original movies and series. Leave a message on the[Joy Line](https://www.siriusxm.com/joyline) for a chance to be featured. **Car:** Ch. 300: Nov. 2–Dec. 27
**App:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Holiday Chill-Out** offers relaxing downtempo electronic and house music for unwinding during the holidays. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Holiday Instrumentals** features instrumental versions of seasonal favorites, with no vocals. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Holiday Pops** celebrates the season with Christmas carols and classical favorites from Handel, Tchaikovsky, the Boston Pops, and more. **Car:** Ch. 66: Dec. 24–25
**App:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Holiday Traditions** plays traditional holiday favorites spanning decades, along with familiar instrumental recordings. **Car:** Ch. 71: Nov. 2–Dec. 27
**App:** Year-round


**Holly** brings merry and bright holiday hits from Mariah Carey, Michael Bublé, Kelly Clarkson, Brenda Lee, and more. **Car:** Ch. 144: Nov. 2–Dec. 27
**App:** Nov. 2–Jan. 6


**Jingle Jamz** features holiday R&B and hip-hop from the ’90s to today, including Boyz II Men, Snoop Dogg, and Mary J. Blige. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Jimmy Fallon’s Holiday Seasoning Radio** features festive songs, celebrity guests, stories, and music from his *Holiday Seasoning* album. Send a greeting via the[Holiday Hotline](https://www.siriusxm.com/holidayhotline) . **Car:** Ch. 14: Nov. 2–Dec. 27
**App:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Jolly Christmas** brings upbeat, singalong holiday hits from Gene Autry and the Chipmunks to Mariah Carey. **Car:** Ch. 608: Nov. 2–Dec. 27
**App:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Kids Christmas** features kid-friendly holiday classics and newer favorites celebrating Santa, Rudolph, and Frosty. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Mannheim Steamroller Channel** showcases Chip Davis and Mannheim Steamroller’s Christmas recordings alongside selections from the *Fresh Aire* series. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Navidad** celebrates Latin Christmas traditions with music from Ricky Martin, Gloria Estefan, José Feliciano, and more. **Car:** Ch. 626: Nov. 2–Jan. 6
**App:** Nov. 2–Jan. 6


**New Year’s Nation** delivers an upbeat mix of the year’s biggest hits to ring in the new year. **Car:** Ch. 144: Dec. 28–Jan. 1


**Noël Incontournable** features French-language holiday classics and contemporary hits from Ginette Reno, Bruno Pelletier, and Laurence Nerbonne. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Radio Hanukkah** presents traditional, contemporary, and children’s Hanukkah music, alongside reflections and prayers. **App only:** Dec. 2–14


**Real Jazz Holiday** features holiday jazz from Ella Fitzgerald and Louis Armstrong to Samara Joy and Christian McBride. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Rockin’ Xmas** delivers rocking Christmas songs from AC/DC, Bon Jovi, Bruce Springsteen, Pearl Jam, and more. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Sleep Christmas** offers gentle, meditative versions of classic Christmas melodies. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Smokey’s Holiday Soul Town** celebrates soulful seasonal sounds from Smokey Robinson, the Miracles, the Supremes, the Jackson 5, and more. **Car:** Ch. 74: Dec. 2–27
**App:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27


**Trans-Siberian Orchestra Radio** features the band’s holiday-rock discography, powerful orchestral arrangements, and exclusive concert recordings. **App only:** Nov. 2–Dec. 27
